name: Progression via Single Bundled POST (Never-Seen-Before Learner)
description: Regression story for the FLP-1858 gating bug: SLD's very first contact with this learner is a single POST bundling two different course codes (ZSC00001, already completed and unapproved, and ZSC00002, a new course) in one OnProgramme array - no prior POST establishes ZSC00001 first. CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler used to compute 'does this learner have any existing Learning' once from the DB before looping the bundled items, so a brand-new learner bundled with 2+ course codes in one request bypassed the ShortCourseProgression gate entirely. Fixed by updating that flag after each item processed within the same request. Asserts both Learnings/episodes are created correctly from the single bundled POST.

steps.name: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 (already completed, unapproved) and ZSC00002 (new course) in a Single Bundled Payload for a learner never seen before
